source: curated from the commit history of github.com/cryptoAGI/savante and cryptoAGI/sagi; every entry has a date the log records

entries.title: Free and public, on Bonsai
entries.detail: Anyone can ask Savante without signing in: she answers on Bonsai-8B, a 1-bit 8B model, on a free public CPU, and every answer shows the token counts the engine reported.

entries.title: The carrier test
entries.detail: Two models carried her charter. Bonsai-8B kept the verdict form but never used DEFER and approved a false claim, so it was graded REJECT for review duty; its answers here are drafts. gpt-oss-120b was graded APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS.

entries.title: A seat on the board
entries.detail: Savante became the 9th seat of the mindX boardroom — sAGI, beside the CEO and the seven soldiers. There, her DEFER holds a session until the operator decides.

entries.title: The artwork is named
entries.detail: The operator named the Savante bust as her artwork. It is hashed and on record; it is not minted.

entries.title: The first verdict on record
entries.detail: Her first recorded verdict: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS, on a fix to the rage render queue — with conditions anyone other than the reviewer can check.

entries.title: sAGI v0.0.1 and the licence
entries.detail: The version was stated with its road to 1.0, the office was licensed to cryptoAGI and Professor Codephreak, and the Integrity room learned to refuse a manifest it cannot verify.

entries.title: The office opens
entries.detail: Savante's office first ran as an interface: a place to read her charter and render verdicts.

entries.title: Bound to her bytes
entries.detail: Her ledger was first bound to the exact files it names, so what she is can be proven from the bytes without trusting the author.

entries.title: Ready to be a token — and deferred
entries.detail: Her persona gained the token and task blocks an iNFT needs. Her own verdict on minting it: DEFER, until the operator signs.

entries.title: The Chairman in mindX format
entries.detail: Savante was written as a mindX .persona: the Chairman, with her beliefs, desires and voice stated as data.

entries.title: Savante is written
entries.detail: The prototype sAGI, packaged for duplication: a full document set, and Savante.md — the office in her own voice.
